THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD
063
STUDY 030
Off-Shoulder Ribbon & Misty Landscape
Rights check
Source: 24548.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long dark hair and a
ribbon tied at the back of her head poses in a
black-and-white portrait. She wears a white
off-shoulder blouse with voluminous puff sleeves and a
small pearl earring. Her expression is calm and
composed. A soft gray, misty landscape painted on the
backdrop, with gentle studio lighting. Monochrome
palette of white, gray, and black. Elegant and classic, in
the style of a vintage studio portrait.
Elegant, soft, classic
WORKING NOTES
- The ribbon and off-shoulder sleeves are the defining
details.
- Describe the backdrop as 'soft, painted mist' for a more
ethereal feel.
Try this: Describe the backdrop as soft, painted mist.
